about: Every rule that turns drawing evidence into build data. Change a number here and re-run run.sh: the schema file, FreeCAD model, IFC, DXF, JSON and trace page are all regenerated from it. Each rule names the evidence it uses; anything that is not evidence is under 'defaults' and is marked as assumed in every output.

DOOR_SNGL@WS-DOOR-GLAZ.evidence: block DOOR_SNGL on layer WS-DOOR-GLAZ (glazed door layer)

DOOR_SNGL@WS-DOOR.evidence: block DOOR_SNGL on layer WS-DOOR (door layer, not glazed)

A$C03859404@WS-DOOR.evidence: unnamed door block on layer WS-DOOR

A$C9e4b0bea@WS-WALL-PRTN.evidence: toilet cubicle block (20 mm partial-height panels on WS-WALL-PHRT plus a door swing)

defaults.about: One coherent default set: common Indian office fit-out build-ups (founder decision 19 Nov 2026: 'Use defaults, mark them'). Every value below is source=default in every output and is listed in ASK_DESIGNER.md for confirmation.
defaults.false_ceiling_note: founder's range 2.7-2.9 m; the web twin uses 3.05 m from an earlier client-team instruction (10 ft). One number; see ASK_DESIGNER Q-H1.
defaults.gypsum_buildup: 2 x 12.5 mm gypsum board on 50 mm GI metal studs (75 mm overall); 100 mm overall when the drawing gives no thickness
defaults.masonry_buildup: solid concrete block (AAC/CC) with 12 mm cement plaster both faces; 230 mm when the drawing gives no thickness

door_frame.solid_door: hardwood 50 x 100 mm with 12 mm beading

glass_partition.frame: aluminium transom bar 45 x 75 mm at door head

full_height_glass.frame: aluminium transom bar 45 x 75 mm at door head

pop_gypsum.frame: gypsum board on metal stud header, POP finish

mixed.frame: gypsum board on metal stud header, POP finish

brick_block.frame: RCC lintel 150 mm deep, block and plaster above

panel_partial_height.frame: cubicle panels stop at 2.1 m; nothing above

_none.frame: gypsum board on metal stud header, POP finish

gypsum_pop.label: gypsum board on metal studs, POP finish

unknown.label: type not settled by the drawing

stud_cavity.label: GI metal studs with mineral wool

wall_rules.drop: the two lines are a column's own outline; the column is built from its outline instead

wall_rules.why: layer STRUCTURAL GLAZING: the building's structural-glazing facade line
layer A.C.P.CLADDING: aluminium composite panel cladding
layer WINDOW, 75 mm line pair (window frame depth)
glazing layer (WS-GLAZ-GLAS = glazing/glass in the layer naming the fit-out designer uses; PR- GLASS = partition glass)
PHRT = partial-height wall in the designer's layer naming; 20 mm line pair = cubicle board
partition layer with a 75-100 mm line pair: dry-wall partition thickness
wall layer, 100-460 mm line pair with wall-hatch lines between the faces (masonry hatch)
fit-out WALL layer (not partition), 105-150 mm line pair: block wall thickness
base-building wall layer, 100-460 mm line pair, no hatch: masonry or RCC cannot be told apart
base-building wall layer but only 30-99 mm apart: lining, shaft board or a drafting double line
a 100 mm line pair on the furniture layer I-FURN (lobby/toilet walls drawn on the wrong layer): it is a wall, but the layer says nothing about its make-up

assemblies.about: Vertical composition per wall type, as bands from the finished floor (z = 0). Heights are names resolved from 'defaults': FC = false ceiling, SOFFIT = slab soffit, F2F = floor to floor. All are source=default. 'layers' is the build-up through the thickness (IfcMaterialLayerSet): fixed layers in metres, REST = drawn thickness minus the fixed layers.

overrides.why: EXAMPLE rule (off in the main run): turn the dry-wall partitions that close the meeting rooms into POP + glass + POP. The drawing does not say this; it shows that one rule change regenerates the floor.

Q-H1.ask: What is the false-ceiling height (finished floor to underside of ceiling) in 603/604? We used 2.90 m (the web twin uses 3.05 m from an earlier client-team note).

Q-H2.ask: Slab soffit and floor-to-floor height? We used soffit 3.35 m, floor to floor 3.60 m, so 0.25 m of slab and screed.

Q-D1.ask: Door head height (top of the door leaf/frame) for all doors? We used 2.10 m.

Q-D2.ask: Above glass doors in glass partitions: glass transom up to the false ceiling (our default), a POP bulkhead, or a full-height door?

Q-D3.ask: Above doors in dry-wall partitions and block walls: the wall continues above the door (POP bulkhead / lintel, our default), or a glass fanlight?

Q-D4.ask: Door frame and beading: glass doors in 45 x 75 mm aluminium (the drawing draws 44 x 75 mm jambs), solid doors in 50 x 100 mm hardwood with 12 mm beading?

Q-D5.ask: Door leaves: 12 mm toughened glass for glazed doors, 35 mm flush for solid doors? Any fire-rated doors (none are marked)?

Q-A1.ask: Are any openings arched (or arch plus window)? The plan has no arch marks, so none were built. If yes, give spring height and radius per opening, or mark them on a layer A-OPEN-ARCH.

Q-G1.ask: Glass partitions (WS-GLAZ-GLAS, drawn 75 mm deep): 12 mm toughened clear glass in a 75 mm aluminium channel top and bottom, floor to false ceiling? Any frosted band or film (height range)? Anything above the false ceiling?
Q-G1.default: 12 mm clear, 50 mm channels, floor to false ceiling, nothing above

Q-P1.ask: Partitions on WS-WALL-PRTN (drawn 75 mm): gypsum board on metal studs or POP on block? Board layers and stud size?
Q-P1.default: 2 x 12.5 mm gypsum on 50 mm studs, POP finish

Q-P2.ask: Do dry-wall partitions run to the slab soffit (our default, for sound) or stop at the false ceiling?

Q-P3.ask: Is any partition a POP + glass + POP wall (solid below, glass vision panel, solid above)? If so, which ones and the band heights (we would use 0-0.9 / 0.9-2.4 / 2.4-ceiling).
Q-P3.default: none (the drawing shows no mixed walls)

Q-M1.ask: Core and toilet walls on layer 'walls' (150/225/300 mm): block, brick or RCC? Unhatched ones especially.

Q-M2.ask: RCC fins on the north face: confirm size and full height.

Q-F1.ask: Structural glazing: glass make-up, mullion spacing and spandrel/back-pan at the slab edge? We built plain glass slab to slab.
Q-F1.default: clear glass slab to slab, no mullions

Q-F2.ask: ACP cladding: which bands of the facade are ACP and their heights? We built the ACP lines full height.

Q-F3.ask: Windows on layer WINDOW: sill height, head height and frame? We built glass from floor to soffit.

Q-F4.ask: Railing height and type at the facade and balconies?

Q-W1.ask: Toilet cubicles (WS-WALL-PHRT, 20 mm): HPL panels 0.15-2.1 m above floor?

Q-U1.ask: Lines on the 'walls' layer only 30-99 mm apart (shaft and lift-well linings?): what are they?
Q-U1.default: built as 'type not settled' in magenta

Q-C1.ask: Columns: RCC, full height to soffit, plastered/boxed? Any column cladding?
Q-C1.default: RCC, floor to soffit, no cladding

Q-S1.ask: False-ceiling type per zone (grid, gypsum, open) and the plate edge: we approximated the slab outline from the facade lines.
Q-S1.default: one flat ceiling over the whole offer

Q-U2.ask: The lobby and toilet-block walls around (70-100, 106-111) are drawn on the furniture layer I-FURN, 100 mm apart: what are they (block, dry wall, glass)? Please move them to a wall layer.
Q-U2.default: built as 'type not settled' in magenta

Q-D6.ask: 39 doors are drawn with no wall piece ending at their swing (list in out/audit/HOST_AUDIT.md): 20 toilet-cubicle doors (their side panels are drawn only as 20 x 79 mm stubs), 8 'DOOR_SNGL', 6 'D-750', 4 'Glass Door' and 1 small door. Still open: the opening for the 8 'Glass Door' blocks (D001, D003, D004, D011, D013, D014, D016, D017), which draw one stile and a line across the opening but no second jamb; and the frame-outside and clear widths for those 8 plus D002, D012, D018, D094 and D097.
